MALE-ATTESTED, APPLIED TO FEMALE VOLUMES. Tayler et al. 2012 identify Crz in four abdominal-ganglion interneurons of what their abstract calls "a male-specific neural pathway"; females are never tested, and the activation experiments are ejaculation in isolated males. INXXX149 is MANC nomenclature and MANC is the MALE adult nerve cord, so the name reaches BANC (female) by morphological matching, and banc_load_meta.R joins VNC truth on bare cell_type -- the name alone carried the call across to four female neurons. Our own data does not corroborate a strongly peptidergic identity for them: they sit at the 69th, 70th, 87th and 87th percentile of BANC soma DCV density (median 80.6th), none clearing the DCV-rich threshold at the 87.2nd, while l_NSC_CRZ -- a real Crz type -- is at the 99.9th. Both our volumes are female (FAFB is a female brain, BANC is female), so the call cannot validly apply to either. This is not a doubt about Tayler et al.; it is the wrong context for their result. Re-admit when a male volume (MANC, maleCNS) is in scope. NB the schema has no sex field, which is why this must be an exclusion rather than a qualifier.
